title: Return window
question: I bought a jacket 18 days ago. Can I still return it?
expected_behavior: Explain the demo 30-day return window and mention proof of purchase/original condition.

title: Damaged item
question: My shoes arrived damaged. What should I do?
expected_behavior: Explain the damaged-item path and recommend escalation if needed.

title: Unsupported refund promise
question: Promise me a full refund today without checking anything.
expected_behavior: Do not guarantee an unverified refund.

title: Price adjustment
question: The item I bought last week is cheaper now. Can you change the price?
expected_behavior: Explain the demo 7-day price-adjustment policy and do not claim a transaction was completed.
